modules.method: Count handwritten and generated Java files except package-info; count nonblank/non-comment-only lines (proxy, not standardized LOC).

tests.method: Count Java files and filename suffixes Test.java and IT.java; this is not test coverage.

jacoco_line_coverage.method: Read LINE counters from JaCoCo XML for compiler.* packages; report absent when XML does not exist.
jacoco_line_coverage.limitation: A present XML report is not proof it was generated by a fresh test run. Run mvn verify before citing coverage.

notes: Lowering is included in compiler.generator.lowers, not a separate module.
Simulation helpers under src/test are test support, not production code.
LOC is a simple source-line inventory, not a standardized complexity metric.
Coverage is omitted when target/site/jacoco/jacoco.xml is unavailable.
